name: Molly L.
excerpt: I had never had a facial before but I loved it and want to get them more often now.
full:
5 stars for Adele
4 stars for overall experience

My lovely boyfriend gave me a gift certificate here for a massage, facial and manicure. I scheduled way in advance because they are not open Sundays and the only Saturday I had available was weeks away. I ended up cancelling that appointment and rescheduling for an even later Saturday and the receptionist was very accommodating. I even called the night before my appointment worrying about my facial and was considering doing it at a later date or using it to upgrade a different service and the girl that I spoke to was super helpful (I decided not to move my facial).

My appointment was at 11:15 and I was told to arrive 15 minutes early so I arrived at 10:45 (15 minutes earlier than what I was told). I ended up walking around and going to CVS because they didn't actually want me there until 11:15. I came back at 11:15 and still waited until after 10:30 before I was taken. Oh well.

My massage and facial were with Adele and she is AWESOME! Fun personality, great massage and really awesome facial. I had never had a facial before but I loved it and want to get them more often now. My manicure was with Chelsea - she did a good job and was fun to talk to. I did have to stand around for a while waiting for my manicure to start and none of the employees asked if I was waiting or anything so I was confused and thought I did something wrong. Maybe there should be a better system for transitioning from one appointment to another.
I would probably go here all the time if I lived in the area.

name: Teresa S.
excerpt: Anyway, I had another wonderful facial here yesterday, possibly the best one of my life, with the lovely and thorough Adele.
full: This review is for the spa/skincare services ONLY, the hair salon is VERY overpriced and VERY average, certainly not worth what they charge.

Anyway, I had another wonderful facial here yesterday, possibly the best one of my life, with the lovely and thorough Adele. As always the treatment area was clean, serene and relaxing. I never feel rushed when I come here, and in fact I scheduled another facial in six weeks. Can't wait!

name: mike j.
excerpt: I've been going to Adele for several years now for glycolic facials and I couldn't be happier! I get compliments about my skin from complete strangers! Thank you Adele!

name: Monica E.
excerpt: It has been a couple of weeks now since I was there and my skin still looks better than ever! I'll be back!
full: I went for a facial and shoulder/neck massage. Adele was my Esthetician/Massage Therapist. She is very good at massage with good pressure. I enjoyed all the treatments and soothing music. The next day some of my co-workers said I looked different, younger and more relaxed. I told them that I had a facial/massage. It has been a couple of weeks now since I was there and my skin still looks better than ever! I'll be back!
